@@U02753@@
Any two would suffice for a monumental building.

@@U02755@@
So that’s what they call Classical! I’m at a loss to know what to praise. It’s clumsy, ponderous is what it is! What’s crude is called noble, and what’s awkward, grand. Give me slender pillars anytime, pillars striving upward into infinity, pointed arches that lift the spirit on high. Now that’s an edifying style!

@@U02757@@
Welcome and reverence these star-favored hours! Let reason be held in abeyance by magic’s power, and audacious fantasy in glorious progress come freely from afar. Behold the scene you so boldly desired. It is impossible, therefore worthy of belief.

@@U02758@@
(浮士德 mounts to the proscenium on the other side.)

@@U02759@@
A wreath on his head and in priestly garments, the man of miracles accomplishes now what he so confidently began. A tripod rises with him out of the depths, and already I smell incense from its brazier. He now prepares to bless the Great Work. Only good fortune may attend him now.

@@U02761@@
(Grandly.)

@@U02762@@
In your name, Mothers, you who sit enthroned in the Boundless, who dwell eternally in Solitude, yet in company!
translation:
@@U02753@@
任何两个都足以建造一座纪念性建筑。

@@U02755@@
这就是他们所说的古典！我不知道该赞扬什么。这很笨拙，很笨重！粗陋的叫做高贵，笨拙的叫做宏伟。随时给我细长的柱子，向上延伸到无限的柱子，尖尖的拱门，将精神提升到高处。现在这是一种启发性的风格！

@@U02757@@
欢迎并崇敬这些明星青睐的时刻！让魔法的力量暂时搁置理性，让大胆的幻想从远方自由地飞来，取得辉煌的进展。看看你如此大胆渴望的场景。这是不可能的，因此值得相信。

@@U02758@@
（浮士德登上另一侧的舞台。）

@@U02759@@
这位创造奇迹的人头戴花环，身着祭司服装，现在完成了他如此自信地开始的事情。一个三脚架随着他从深处升起，我已经闻到了它的火盆的香气。他现在准备祝福伟大的工作。现在只有好运会眷顾他了。

@@U02761@@
（庄严地。）

@@U02762@@
以你们的名义，母亲们，你们坐在无边的宝座上，你们永远居住在孤独中，但却与同伴在一起！
